FINAL WORDS

Rules

Eight scrambled words to unscramble, in this order: 5, 6, 7 and 8 letters, then again 5, 6, 7 and 8 letters.

You have 2 minutes for the whole game. Type your answer or tap the letters. Each correct word scores 1 point per letter.

You can skip a word and come back to it later. The music plays during the game, and the final sound signals the end of time. The answers appear once the music is over.
